base_pose:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: NEW full-body reusable base pose for page 17 of a children's picture book. Output one isolated gray child with genuine transparent alpha, ideally a native 2048 x 2048 PNG, no scenery.
References: image 1 is the existing gray climbing pose and specifies the simple face, dark eyebrows, bald head, neutral one-piece gray bodysuit, paper texture, subtle gray shading and restrained outline. Image 2 is the approved new page-7 pose; match the same child's proportions and three-quarter side/back visual language. Image 3 is orientation and ground-angle context ONLY, not an output background: a golden path rises diagonally from bottom left to upper right toward a warm crystal cave at upper right.
New action: a child genuinely walking UPHILL toward screen-right and away from the viewer, not marching toward the camera. Use a three-quarter rear/side view with enough near-side face visible for one eye, eyebrow, cheek and nose. Head and gaze face up and right toward the cave entrance, with calm curiosity and determination. Give a subtle forward lean at the torso from effort, around 12 to 18 degrees. Leading leg at screen-right is flexed and stepping onto a HIGHER part of the invisible slope. Trailing leg extends back toward screen-left, pushing off LOWER ground. Both feet must clearly relate to one common uphill surface inclined about 25 degrees, with the front foot visibly higher than the rear, and each sole oriented naturally to the incline. Avoid a floating raised foot or a high-knee marching pose. Near arm bends slightly forward at waist/chest height and far arm moves slightly back for walking balance; relaxed hands, not raised fists, not reaching or waving. Entire body in profile/three-quarter rear facing right, no looking at viewer.
Keep the same toddler/young-child head/body ratio, rounded head, short limbs, simple facial geometry, no hair, no eyelashes, no gendered details, gray face, gray eyebrows, neutral gray bodysuit INCLUDING hands and feet. No colored clothes, no shoes, no accessories, no added objects, no rocks or ground plane. Preserve the clean flat picture-book style and light paper grain, not 3D realism. Leave clear transparent space on all sides with every fingertip, bald scalp and both feet fully contained. No cast shadow, no white rectangle, no background, no text, no watermark, no drawn checkerboard. Single pose, not a sheet.
personalized_preview:
Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Make a colored children's-book character pose on genuine transparent background, ideally native 2048 x 2048. Input image 1 is the exact uphill action and camera angle to preserve: full body in three-quarter rear/side view moving toward screen-right and upward, head/gaze up and right, leading right-side leg bent with front foot planted high, trailing left-side leg extended back to lower ground with heel raised, arms moving naturally for balance. Retain this uphill stance and its roughly 25-degree implied slope. Do not straighten both feet onto a horizontal baseline, do not turn toward the viewer, and do not use the old front-facing marching pose.
Input image 2 supplies only the personalized identity and art style from the newly approved page-7 preview: warm tan skin, short side-swept brown hair, simple large brown eyes, blue short-sleeved shirt, blue-gray shorts and pale blue sneakers, flat softly textured paper-painted forms. Apply that exact child and outfit to the pose in image 1. Near side of face visible with one clear eye and eyebrow, a small calm curious smile, gaze toward the cave above and to the right. Preserve the same round child head and short-limbed proportions. Both sneaker soles must align to the implied uphill incline, with front shoe visibly higher than trailing shoe. Keep intact opaque eye whites; no transparent holes inside the face. Full figure entirely inside the canvas with generous transparent space around hair, hands and both shoes. One child only. No ground, mountain, cave, rocks, scenery, cast shadow, text, watermark, opaque panel or drawn checkerboard. Clean alpha edges, no disconnected specks, no thick black outline, no 3D rendering.
